title: hobby-kernel — C/RISC-V 토이 커널
description: C로 바닥부터 만든 RISC-V 토이 커널. 부팅·페이징(가상메모리)·프로세스·시스템콜·fork/exec·파일시스템, 그리고 demand paging·mmap·copy-on-write·멀티코어(SMP)·네트워크(UDP/TCP)·유저 스레드·저널링 FS — xv6(MIT 6.S081) 학습 랩을 전부 직접 구현해 11편 연재로 정리한 학습 프로젝트(상용 OS 아님).
descriptionEn: A RISC-V toy kernel built from scratch in C — boot, paging (virtual memory), processes, system calls, fork/exec, a filesystem, plus demand paging, mmap, copy-on-write, multicore (SMP), networking (UDP/TCP), user threads, and a journaling FS. Implements the full set of xv6 (MIT 6.S081) labs, documented as an 11-part series.
